```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(R2jags)
library(coda)
library(patchwork)

main_path <- getwd()
data_path <- file.path(main_path, "data/cleaned_data")
study_1_path <- file.path(main_path, "study_1")
results_path <- file.path(main_path, "results")
models_path <- file.path(main_path, "models")
figure_path <- file.path(study_1_path, "figures")

set.seed(7386)

demographics <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "demographics.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
sound_events <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "sound_events.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

source(file.path(main_path, "overall_functions.R"))
```

```{r}
# analytic sample
dem_analytic <- demographics %>%
  filter(!excluded, setup == "COOP")

analytic_ids <- dem_analytic %>%
  distinct(id)

sound_analytic <- sound_events %>%
  filter(setup == "COOP") %>%
  semi_join(analytic_ids, by = "id")
```

## Hierarchical Beta-Bernoulli model
### Estimates gender differences in pressing among dyads with at least one press, while allowing the female press probability to vary across dyads
```{r}
# The Beta-Bernoulli outcome is responder gender conditional on a button press.
# Dyads that never pressed are therefore excluded. 
# Within retained dyads, no-press events are coded NA and do not contribute observed Bernoulli outcomes.
simple_press <- sound_analytic %>%
  mutate(
    y = case_when(
      responder_gender == "Female" ~ 1,
      responder_gender == "Male" ~ 0,
      responder_gender == "none" ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  filter(any(!is.na(y))) %>%
  arrange(sound_event_order, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(event_number = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

simple_press %>%
  summarise(
    n_dyads = n_distinct(id),
    n_events = n(),
    n_presses = sum(!is.na(y)),
    n_female_presses = sum(y == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_male_presses = sum(y == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

y_wide <- simple_press %>%
  dplyr::select(id, event_number, y) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = event_number, values_from = y) %>%
  arrange(id)

for (j in 1:8) {
  col_name <- as.character(j)
  if (!col_name %in% names(y_wide)) {
    y_wide[[col_name]] <- NA_real_
  }
}

y_wide <- y_wide %>%
  dplyr::select(id, `1`, `2`, `3`, `4`, `5`, `6`, `7`, `8`)

y_mat <- y_wide %>%
  dplyr::select(-id) %>%
  as.matrix()

storage.mode(y_mat) <- "numeric"

data_list_hier <- list(
  N = nrow(y_mat),
  y = y_mat
)

params_hier <- c(
  "mu", "nu", "alpha", "beta", "p", "pop_p",
  "mu_prior", "nu_prior", "alpha_prior", "beta_prior", "pop_p_prior", "p_prior")

samples_path_hier <- file.path(results_path, "s1_jags_buttonpress_hierarchical_bernoulli.rds")

if (file.exists(samples_path_hier)) {
  samples_hier <- readRDS(samples_path_hier)
} else {
  samples_hier <- jags.parallel(
    data = data_list_hier,
    inits = NULL,
    parameters.to.save = params_hier,
    model.file = file.path(models_path, "s1_Hierarchy_Bernoulli.bugs"),
    n.chains = 12,
    n.iter = 25000,
    n.burnin = 5000,
    n.thin = 1
  )
  saveRDS(samples_hier, samples_path_hier)
}

samples_hier

s_hier <- as.matrix(as.mcmc(samples_hier))
mu_draws <- s_hier[, "mu"]

# Savage-Dickey BF01 for H0: mu = .50.
# Under mu ~ Beta(1,1), the prior density at .50 equals 1.

d_post_mu <- density(mu_draws)
post_at_half_mu <- approx(d_post_mu$x, d_post_mu$y, xout = 0.5)$y
prior_at_half_mu <- 1
bf01_hier <- post_at_half_mu / prior_at_half_mu
round(bf01_hier, 2)


tibble(mu = mu_draws) %>%
  ggplot(aes(mu)) +
  geom_density() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = 2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Posterior for population mean female press probability (BF01 ≈ ", round(bf01_hier, 2), ")"),
    x = "mu",
    y = "Density"
  )

p_summary <- samples_hier$BUGSoutput$summary %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("parameter") %>%
  filter(str_detect(parameter, "^p\\[")) %>%
  mutate(
    dyad_index = str_extract(parameter, "\\d+") %>%
      as.integer()
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    dyad_index,
    mean = mean,
    lower = `2.5%`,
    upper = `97.5%`
  )

dyad_lookup <- y_wide %>%
  arrange(id) %>%
  distinct(id) %>%
  mutate(dyad_index = row_number())

```


```{r}
plot_png_path <- file.path(figure_path, "s1_buttonpress_beta_bernoulli_traceplots.png")

if (!file.exists(plot_png_path)) {
  mcmc_list_bb <- as.mcmc(samples_hier)

  trace_df_bb <- purrr::map2_dfr(
    mcmc_list_bb,
    seq_along(mcmc_list_bb),
    ~ as.data.frame(.x) %>%
      rownames_to_column("iteration") %>%
      mutate(
        iteration = as.integer(iteration),
        chain = paste0("chain_", .y)
      )
  ) %>%
    dplyr::select(iteration, chain, mu, nu, pop_p) %>%
    group_by(chain) %>%
    slice(seq(1, n(), by = 20)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(mu, nu, pop_p),
      names_to = "parameter",
      values_to = "value"
    )

  p_trace_bb <- ggplot(trace_df_bb, aes(x = iteration, y = value, colour = chain)) +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.25) +
    facet_wrap(~ parameter, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = "Traceplots: hierarchical Beta-Bernoulli",
      x = "Iteration",
      y = "Value",
      colour = "Chain"
    )

  show_or_save_ggplot(
    plot_png_path = plot_png_path,
    plot_object = p_trace_bb,
    width = 8,
    height = 8,
    dpi = 300
  )
} else {
  show_or_save_ggplot(plot_png_path = plot_png_path)
}
```


```{r}
# dyad bias plot

plot_df_press_only <- p_summary %>%
  left_join(dyad_lookup, by = "dyad_index") %>%
  arrange(mean) %>%
  mutate(plot_id = row_number())

plot_png_path <- file.path(figure_path, "s1_buttonpress_dyad_gender_bias.png")

if (!file.exists(plot_png_path)) {
  p_dyad_bias <- ggplot(plot_df_press_only, aes(x = mean, y = plot_id)) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = 0.005, xmax = 0.495,
    ymin = 0, ymax = max(plot_df_press_only$plot_id) + 1,
    alpha = 0.15, fill = "#eb8005"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = 0.505, xmax = 0.995,
    ymin = 0, ymax = max(plot_df_press_only$plot_id) + 1,
    alpha = 0.15, fill = "#2A9D8F"
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = 2, colour = "red", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper),
    width = 0.15, linewidth = 0.4, orientation = "y"
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 1.7) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0.25,
    y = Inf,
    label = "Male-dominant",
    vjust = -0.8,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0.75,
    y = Inf,
    label = "Female-dominant",
    vjust = -0.8,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Estimated female press probability",
    y = "Dyad (ordered by probability estimate)"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10)
  )

  show_or_save_ggplot(
    plot_png_path = plot_png_path,
    plot_object = p_dyad_bias,
    width = 8,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300
  )
} else {
  show_or_save_ggplot(plot_png_path = plot_png_path)
}

plot_png_path <- file.path(figure_path, "s1_buttonpress_beta_bernoulli_prior_posterior.png")

plot_bb_mu <- plot_prior_posterior(
  draws = s_hier,
  posterior_name = "mu",
  prior_name = "mu_prior",
  xlab = "Population-level female press probability",
  vline = 0.5,
  central_prob = 0.99
) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(8, 12, 8, 12)
  )

plot_bb_pop <- plot_prior_posterior(
  draws = s_hier,
  posterior_name = "pop_p",
  prior_name = "pop_p_prior",
  xlab = "Population distribution of dyad-level female press probabilities",
  vline = 0.5,
  central_prob = 0.99
) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(8, 12, 8, 12)
  )

p_bb_prior_post <-
  (plot_bb_mu / plot_bb_pop) +
  plot_annotation(
    theme = theme(
      plot.margin = margin(
        t = 20,
        r = 35,
        b = 25,
        l = 35
      )
    )
  )

show_or_save_ggplot(
  plot_png_path = plot_png_path,
  plot_object = p_bb_prior_post,
  width = 9,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```
